prompt: Event candidates are chronological dashcam frames, sampled from a local window plus the true clip start. No reliable vehicle reference is available; use the whole frames. Choose when that collision vehicle FIRST touches the camera car lane boundary with a wheel. Extend the camera car lane through an intersection. A local-window first image may be later than the beginning. True clip first frame is 0; choose it only if already inside at the true beginning. Later reentry is not first entry. Allowed event frames: [0, 10, 19, 29, 39, 48, 58, 68, 77, 87, 97, 106, 116, 126, 135, 145]. Return JSON with entry_frame only, or null if unknown.
